prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 19 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1070; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force of the collision and with the pattern of symptoms described. Over the course of 19 visits, care proceeded along a typical trajectory, beginning with assessment and physical therapy, followed by a home exercise program. Frequency of visits decreased steadily as pain and function improved. Examination revealed limited abduction and a positive impingement sign, while strength testing and neurovascular findings were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment involving this shoulder is known to this provider. Billed services correspond to the documented visits, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified. Patient was discharged to self-directed exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
